system.description: The Assamites have spread over an immense stretch of territory, and you have encountered a wider array of cultures than most other Cainites can conceive of — whether in life or unlife. You have gained an almost instinctive understanding of how to blend in and avoid giving offense. You enjoy a one-Trait bonus on all attempts to move smoothly through a foreign society (speaking the language is still a separate matter of Linguistics), reflexively coming across as familiar and knowledgeable in areas where other outlanders would be lost. This also covers such tasks as passing as a native where you don't belong, such as a French Assamite hiding from German Ventrue pursuers in the markets of Constantinople.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
